cautions.en: No public price grid found on the official site; pricing is distributed through accounting-firm and integrator partners, not sold directly to end users at a listed rate.

capabilities.en: Payroll production, control, and validation flow through to the payslip (bulletin), including automated DSN (French mandatory payroll declaration) generation.
Support for 900+ French collective bargaining agreements (conventions collectives).
HR/SIRH modules: employee lifecycle, time tracking, leave management, telework management, electronic signature.
Additional modules: social reporting BI (mySilae BI), benefits management (mySilae Santé), expense management (mySilae Expense), legal document generation (mySilae Contrats).

limitations.en: Distribution model targets accounting firms, payroll BPOs and integrators rather than direct self-serve signup, so an individual freelancer or small team cannot easily buy or price it alone.
No public pricing, so cost cannot be compared without contacting a partner or sales.

reason.en: French accounting/finance platform used by similar accounting-firm and SME customers.
Business spend and finance management alternative for European SMEs.
French all-in-one management software for small businesses, adjacent to payroll/admin needs.

missingAlternatives.name: PayFit
missingAlternatives.reason: Leading direct-to-SME French payroll competitor, self-serve unlike Silae's partner-only model, not present in the candidate list.

unknowns: No pricing figures published; distribution is via accounting firms and integrators (partner network), so comparePlanKey and price fields cannot be filled.
Whether an individual freelancer/small team can subscribe directly is unclear from the homepage.
